description: Explain how a value in a Valem card was computed: the formula, the values it read and the inputs it ultimately comes from, as Valem's engine has them for the given inputs. Use it when the user asks why a number is what it is. Pass the specHash and current inputs from the latest render_model result or card update.

inputs.description: The card's current inputs keyed by canonical path; omit for the defaults.

path.description: The field to explain, as a canonical path, e.g. "$.total" or "$.items[0].lineTotal".

spec.description: The spec, only needed when the server answers spec_unknown.

specHash.description: The specHash from the render_model result.

name: explain_value
title: Explain a Valem value
